scores.visual_critic_note: Polished card UI and technically impressive 8-layout morphing demo, but Tableau10 preset palette, a cluttered control/credits footer, and no typographic or color craft beyond competent defaults keep it squarely functional.
scores.encoding_integrity_note: Correct scaleSqrt for radius encoding, data-driven domains via d3.extent, proper key functions on all data joins, and no zero-baseline violations since no bar/area charts are used.
scores.stress_test_note: Easing param sliders fire full updateLayout() (layout compute + flubber interpolators for 200+ nodes) on every mousemove input event with no debounce; no explicit .interrupt() before new transitions; no touch event filtering on drag handlers.
scores.cognitive_load_note: The circle-pack hierarchy reads clearly with well-separated color groups, but 300 edges at 8% bundle tension converge into an unreadable dark hairball at the center, and the 8-layout control panel adds significant cognitive overhead before the viewer even engages with the data.

proposer: 779 lines, down from 783. The changes: merged two `root.descendants().forEach` loops (-3 lines), inlined `descendantCounts` (-1 line), replaced `root.sum(...)` with `root.count()`, and removed redundant `.id(d => d.id)` from stratify. All functional behavior preserved.
